title: Integrate remaining deformable and smoke coupling operators
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Move existing non-rigid/non-liquid cloth/soft/rope/smoke interactions onto the one-tick shared snapshot, without adding new pair/mode semantics. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Map every applicable existing pair/mode to its single-step operator and independent case; explicitly exclude unsupported pairs instead of claiming all couplings.
Validate two-way balance, stable contact, mass ratios, self/same-family modes where supported, cold starts and three-plus-family scenes under F8-00.
Reuse one spatial epoch, integrate each endpoint once and cap algebraic iterations; smoke field steps remain grid operations without extra collision-index rebuilds.
Test lifecycle, topology/endpoint replacement, overflow and reset; publish operator-level dispatch/quality budgets and documented approximation errors.
